library_typings_note: The library is not yet installed in app/node_modules. Story 1 installs it; after that, read typings at app/node_modules/@941design/marmot/dist (client/create-client.d.ts is the core contract; history/index.d.ts the HistoryBackend contract).
key_findings: MarmotContext.tsx (3096 lines) is the composition root; ~14.6k lines of hand-rolled plumbing in app/src/lib/marmot.
Library owns 445 group sync (auto-started by groups.list/create/accept) and the 1059 inbox (inbox.start()); one client per account; per-account IndexedDB with exclusive Web-Lock lease.
HistoryBackend is the durable at-least-once ordered delivery seam (5 attempts, 10s timeout, idempotent by kind-445 eventId) — replaces rumorJournal + applicationRumorDispatcher.
Engine binds rumor.pubkey to MLS-authenticated sender; orderingKey.account is the sender.
Own messages echo back as confirmed message notifications; abandoned own sends are never announced.
group.invite takes key-package EVENTS (kind 30443), one leaf per event, whole call rejects on any invalid event.
No public KP fetch; no disband initiation; no pending-invite group name; no NDK adapters (use createSimplePoolNetwork + fromForeignSigner APPLESAUCE_SHAPE).
Inbox handlers run inside a re-entrancy frame: record and return; follow-up client calls via setTimeout(0), never microtasks.
Loaded groups refuse invite/removeMember/setAdmins/rename/leave with commit-pending until group.synced().
next.config.mjs routes ts-mls/marmot-ts/@hpke/@noble/post-quantum through next-swc-loader and sets swcMinify:false; tsconfig moduleResolution bundler.
Unit tests: vitest 4, tests/unit/**/*.test.ts, no jsdom; 161 files reference marmot-ts/ts-mls or src/lib/marmot/MarmotContext; many are source-scan tests.
E2E: relay bucket = groups-*/dm-* filenames; helpers in app/tests/e2e/helpers/group-setup.ts; __fewTest hooks used by several specs; definitive gate make test (unit + make test-e2e-all).
